name: Qazaq Kuresi
description: The ancient, pride-filled national wrestling style of Kazakhstan. A dynamic sport where athletes wear specific durable jackets, battling on the mat using only upper-body throws, trips, and incredible leverage, deeply rooted in nomadic warrior history.

name: Bandy
description: Often called 'winter football'. A fast, high-endurance team sport played on a massive sheet of ice the size of a soccer field, using skates, curved sticks, and a small pink ball.

name: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
description: The ultimate cage-bound testing ground. A raw, high-stakes combat sport blending boxing, Muay Thai, wrestling, and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu into a tactical chess match of survival.

name: Brailie Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ)
description: The gentle art of human chess. A ground-based martial art focusing entirely on leverage, position dominant control, and joint-locks or chokeholds to submit larger opponents.

name: Marathon Running
description: The ultimate test of human oxygen utilization and mental grit. A grueling 42.195-kilometer road race against hitting 'the wall' and total physical exhaustion.

name: Water Polo
description: An incredibly exhausting sport combining swimming, handball tactics, and aggressive physical treading. Players cannot touch the bottom and must pass and shoot with one hand.

name: Fencing
description: A lightning-fast, elegant martial art of blades. Utilizing foils, épées, or sabers, it demands rapid-fire analytical thinking, pinpoint accuracy, and explosive lunges.

name: American Football
description: A high-impact, gridiron battle of complex playbook strategies, explosive sprints, bone-rattling tackles, and territorial precision across four intense quarters.

name: Mountain Biking (Downhill)
description: A high-adrenaline, gravity-fueled rush down technical, rocky mountain trails, launching over huge gaps and negotiating slick roots at terrifying speeds.

name: Rowing
description: The ultimate team symphony of absolute physical agony. Athletes pull oars in perfect, synchronized rhythm across flat water tracks to test maximal oxygen limits.

name: Handball
description: A relentless, hyper-fast indoor court sport where two teams bounce, pass, and aggressively throw a ball into a goal while battling hard physical defenses.

name: Wrestling (Freestyle)
description: One of the pure original olympic disciplines. A grueling battle of absolute leverage, core power, pins, and takedowns with zero weapons or striking allowed.

name: Figure Skating
description: A beautiful yet incredibly athletic fusion of dance, theatre, and physics. Skaters execute multi-rotation aerial jumps and intricate edge spins on cold, unforgiving ice.

name: Baseball
description: America's pastime. A deeply strategic summer game of pitch variations, explosive bat swings, outfield tracking, and complex base-running decisions.

name: Kickboxing
description: A standing-only combat sport combining classical western boxing punches with fluid, high-velocity kicks. Focuses on relentless cardio and heavy pad conditioning.

name: Triathlon
description: The ultimate endurance multi-sport. Athletes endure a continuous multi-stage race consisting of open-water swimming, long-distance road cycling, and a final marathon.

name: Badminton
description: A deceptively fast-paced racket sport where a feather shuttlecock can fly at blinding speeds, demanding extreme diving agility and rapid overhead smashes.

name: Parkour
description: The art of efficient urban movement. Practitioners treat concrete landscapes as obstacles, using flips, cat-leaps, vaults, and precise balancing maneuvers.

name: Kendo
description: The spiritual Way of the Sword. A modern Japanese martial art using bamboo swords (shinai) and protective armor, emphasizing shouting spirit and decisive strikes.

name: Equestrian (Show Jumping)
description: A masterclass of non-verbal harmony between rider and horse. Demands perfect stride calculation, high-speed agility, and absolute trust over massive timber fences.

name: Ski Jumping
description: An incredible test of pure aerodynamic flight. Skiers blast down a steep massive ramp, launching into the void to float over a hundred meters down a snowy mountain.

name: Windsurfing
description: A dynamic board sport merging sailing physics with surfing flow. Riders harness ocean winds to glide, jump, and loop over rolling surface waves.

name: Squash
description: A fast, punishing indoor racket sport played inside a small four-walled court. The ball behaves erratically, creating an intense high-cardio chess match.

name: Powerlifting
description: A pure, non-explosive pursuit of absolute human strength. Centered completely on maximizing the maximal weight lifted across three main lifts: Squat, Bench, and Deadlift.

name: Kayaking (Whitewater)
description: A chaotic battle against rushing river currents. Paddlers navigate technical river drops, hydraulics, and jagged boulder traps inside a tightly sealed plastic hull.
